2026-11-04.homeNewsDetails: Ellis is in the starter's crease at Buffalo's morning skate.
2026-11-04.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Ellis has started two of the past three games for the Sabres and will return to the crease on Wednesday. The Sabres enter Wednesday's action as -126 home favourites against an Ottawa Senators team that has lost three of their last four games (1-2-1).

The Senators enter Wednesday's game as +113 road underdogs against a Buffalo Sabres team with points in four straight games (3-0-1).
